## AipmConfigInput.description property

Optional one-line description of the plugin. When the repo opts into registry generation (an `aipm.workspace.ts` is present), this becomes the plugin entry's `description` (Claude/Cursor) in the generated `marketplace.json`<!-- -->. Optional so existing configs stay valid.

**Signature:**

```typescript
description?: string;
```
